plan: The goal is to maximize profit. Since I pay the second-highest bid, bidding my true value is a dominant strategy in a second-price auction. This ensures that I win only when my value is greater than what I pay, and I never lose profit by overbidding. I will bid my value of $31.

This is a Vickrey auction (second-price sealed-bid). The optimal strategy in a Vickrey auction is to bid your true value. This strategy is dominant, meaning it's the best strategy regardless of what other bidders do. Bidding my true value of $22 maximizes my profit in the long run, as it guarantees I win when my value is higher than the second-highest bid and I pay no more than my value.

Given my value of $40, I need to bid strategically to maximize profit. Since I pay the second-highest bid, bidding my true value is a good baseline. However, I can try to shade my bid slightly below my value to increase profit if I win, or slightly above to increase my chances of winning if the other bids are close.
